text.body:
prathamaḥ sargaḥ
avyādāpūrayad vaṃśam avyājamadhurasmitam | gokulānucaraṃ dhāma gopikānetramohanam || 1 || vaṃśe mahati sudhāṃśoḥ pāṇḍusutapravaracaritaparipūte | āsīd apāramahimā mahīśvaro rāmarāja iti || 2 || udapādi timmarājas tato ’mbudher iva sudhāmayān maṇirājaḥ | hṛdayaṅgamaṃ murārer yamalaṃ cakre prabheva gopīdevī || 3 || rājarṣir eṣa suciraṃ dhuri sthitas satyasandhānām | ārādhya veṅkaṭeśvaram alabhata lokottarān putrān || 4 || teṣu mahiteṣu jayati tridivādhīśeṣu padmabandhur iva | śrīcinnatimmarājaḥ pratāpanīrājitakṣamāvalayaḥ || 5 || plavamānasya samudre setoś śaithilyaśaṅkayā nihitāḥ | kīlā iva bhāsante tatratyā yasya pṛthujayastambhāḥ || 6 || malayādrikaṭakanikaṭe vindhya ivābhāti yajjayastambhaḥ | adyāpi nāgato ’sīty agastyam anuyoktum antikonmagnaḥ || 7 || abhibhavati kālameghaṃ ravikaranikaraṃ tiras kurute | yad dānavārisāgarajanmā jagadadbhuto yaśaścandraḥ || 8 || sūktimayaiḥ svaprabhavair amṛtair āpyāyayan sadā vibudhān | kulakūṭasthasyendor ācāraṃ yo ’nuvartate dhīraḥ || 9 || sāhityagoṣṭhīṃ sarasām ātiṣṭhan nayam ekadā | yādavābhyudayaṃ kāvyam aśrauṣīd viduṣāṃ mukhāt || 10 || avyākhyātatayā pūrvair anabhivyaktabhāvakam | aghṛṣṭam iva śilpajñair abhijātaṃ harinmaṇim || 11 || tadā karṇanataḥ sadyaḥ samudañcatkutūhalaḥ | viduṣāṃ puratas tasya vivṛtau māṃ nyayojayat || 12 || kavitārkikasiṃhasya kāvyam etad yathāmati | vivṛṇomi mahīpālaniyogabahumānataḥ || 13 ||
tatra tāvat ‘‘āśīrnamaskriyā vastunirdeśo vāpi tanmukham |’’ [KD 1.14] iti śāstram anusṛtya viśiṣṭeṣṭadevatānamaskāralakṣaṇaṃ maṅgalam ācāryaḥ prathamaśloke nibandhāti ---
vande bṛndāvanacaraṃ vallavījanavallabham | jayantīsaṃbhavaṃ dhāma vaijayantīvibhūṣaṇam || 1 ||
vanda iti | bṛndāvanaṃ nāma mathuropakaṇṭhe vanaviśeṣaḥ tatra caratīti bṛndāvanacaram ‘‘careṣṭaḥ’’ [Pa_3,2.16] iti ṭapratyayaḥ | ‘‘tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam |’’ [Pa_6,3.14] ity alugvidhānasya bāhulakatvāt supo luk | vallavyo gopajātistriyaḥ | vallavaśabdāj jātilakṣaṇo ṅīṣ | vallavya iti janā vallavījanā iti karmadhārayaḥ strīliṅgasya paranimittasyābhāvāt ‘‘puṃvat karmadhāraya’’ [Pa_6,3.42] ityādināṃ vallavīśabdasya na puvadbhāvaḥ | teṣāṃ vallabhaṃ ‘‘satyavāgārjavaratair upakurvan priyaṃ vadan | bhajate yaḥ svayaṃ pūrṇaḥ priyaḥ sa bhavati striyāḥ |’’ [BP_5] {1} ity uktalakṣaṇaṃ priyam | ‘‘dayitaṃ vallabhaṃ priyam |’’ [AK_3,1.109] ity amaraḥ | jayantī rohiṇīsahitā śrāvaṇamāsasya kṛṣṇāṣṭamī ‘‘jaya puṇyaś ca tanute jayantī tena tā viduḥ |’’ *[n.i.]* iti paurāṇikair niruktā | pṛṣodarāditvāt sādhuḥ | tasyāṃ sambhavaṃ prādurbhūtaṃ bhavateḥ pacādyac | ‘‘ajvidhis sarvadhātubhyaḥ’’ [KV_3,1.134] iti vacanāt | saptamīti yogavibhāgāt samāsaḥ | vaijayantī vanamālā sā vibhūṣaṇaṃ yasya tathābhūtaṃ | dhāma svaprakāśajyotirmayaṃ vastu vāsudevākhyam vande praṇamāmīti yojanā | vanda iti vartamānanirdeśaḥ svavandanasya sadānuvṛttiparaḥ, na tu prabandhārambhasamayavartamānatvamātraparaḥ | saṅkoce hetvabhāvāt | sakṛt prapadanamātreṇābhīṣṭaprade bhagavati satāṃ bhaktivaśāt tadanusandhānaviśeṣarūpasya mānasanamaskārasya sadānuvṛtteḥ | viśeṣaṇabalād eva bhagavān vāsudevo viśeṣya labhyata iti viśiṣya viśeṣyānirdeśaḥ | yathāha vāmanaḥ ‘‘viśeṣaṇamātraprayogo viśeṣyapratipattau’’ [KAS_5,1.10] iti | bhagavatas sukhasevyatvopayuktāś catvāro guṇāḥ vātsalyaṃ, sauśīlyaṃ, saulabhyaṃ, svāmitvam iti | tatra vātsalyaṃ vatse dhenor iva snehaḥ | sauśīlyaṃ mahato mandaiḥ saha nīrandhrasaśleṣasvabhāvaḥ | saulabhyaṃ labdhuṃ suśakatvaṃ sukhena sannidhānadātṛtvam | svāmitvaṃ svakīyatvābhimānaḥ | vātsalyena sevakasya svāparādhabhayam, sauśīlyena parameśvaratāprayuktānabhigamyatvabhayam, saulabhyena ‘‘na sandṛśe tiṣṭhati rūpam asya’’ [PaU_19] ityādivedāntavākyaśravaṇakṛtāgocaratvabhayam, svāmitvena vātsalyādimūlabhūtasaṃbandhābhāvabhayaṃ ca nivartyata ity eteṣāṃ sukhasevyatve upayogaḥ | krameṇa ete guṇāḥ viśeṣaṇavatuṣṭayenānusahitāḥ | tatra govatsānucaryārūpabṛndāvanasañcārapratipādakenādyaviśeṣaṇena tiryagjātisādhāraṇam tasya vātsalyaṃ vyajyate | nikhilavanitājanamūrddhanyaśrīmahālakṣmīnirantarāśleṣanityatṛptasya pāmarajātistrījanasaśleṣaḥ sauśīlyaikakṛta iti dyotayitum eva dvitīyaviśeṣaṇe vallavīti ṅīṣā | tāsāṃ gopajātīyatvam uktam | janaśabdenāpi pāmaratvavācinā sauśīlyam eva sthirīkriyate | ‘‘jano loke maharlokāt paraloke ca paṭhyate | ’’ *[n.i.]* iti viśvaprakāśaḥ | ata eva janaśabdasyāpy arthavattā | tṛtīyaviśeṣaṇenāvatārarūpatvoktyā saulabhyaṃ vyajyate | ‘‘yasyāvatārarūpāṇi’’ [VP_1,19.80] ityādiṣv avatārāṇāṃ saulabhyaprasiddheḥ | caturthaviśeṣaṇena ‘‘svāṃ māyāṃ vaijayantī vanamālākhyānā guṇamayī dadhāti’’ *[n.i.]* iti śrībhāgavatoktarītyā māyārūpāyā vai jayantyā bhūṣaṇatayā viśeṣaṇatvapratipādanena māyādhiṣṭhānajagatkāraṇabrahmarūpatvābhivyaktyā svāmitvaṃ vyajyate | ‘‘sa kāraṇaṃ karaṇādhipādhipaḥ’’ [SU_6.9] iti jīvān prati svāmitvaśruteḥ | anenaiva viśeṣaṇena jagatkāraṇabrahmarūpatvasyākṣiptatayā sarvajñatvasarvaśaktitvādayo bhagavataḥ kāryakaratvopayogiguṇā apy anusaṃhitāḥ | prabandhanirmāṇarūpaprastutakāryaviśeṣopayogitayā dhāmeti jñānaśaktiprādhānyena bhagavān anusahitaḥ | api ca ebhir eva viśeṣaṇair asya kāvyasya prekṣāvatpravṛttyupayogiviṣayaprayojanasūcanam api kriyate | tathā hi | bṛndāvanacaram ityādinā viśeṣaṇatrayeṇa bhagavato bṛndāvanasañcārādikaṃ caritam asya viṣaya iti sūcyate | tenaiva tasya śṛṅgāravīrādbhutarasabharitatvavibhāvanāt tadāsvādaḥ prayojanam iti sūcyate | jayantīsaṃbhavam iti bhagavadāvirbhāvatithau jayantīpadaprayogeṇa tasya jayaśīlatvavyañjanena taccaritasya vīrarasamayatvaṃ vibhāvyate | vallavījanavallabham ity anena śṛṅgārapracuratvam | bṛndāvanacaram ity anena bṛndāvanacaritagovarddhanoddharaṇādikṛtādbhutarasaprāyatvam iti | śṛṅgāravīrādbhutamayatvād bhagavataḥ śrīkṛṣṇasya | yad vakṣyati dvitīyasarge devakīgabhavarṇane ‘‘śṛṅgāravīrādbhutacitram antas tasyās trilokaikanidhiṃ vahantyā |’’ *[n.i.]* iti | tatra vīrarasaḥ pradhānabhūtaḥ, bhūbhārāvataraṇārthatvād avatārasya | tatprādhānyaṃ dyotayituṃ tadvyañjakaviśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyasannihitaṃ kṛtaṃ ‘‘jayantīsaṃbhavaṃ dhāma’’ iti | eva avāntaraprayojanaṃ viśeṣaṇatrayeṇa vibhāvyate | paramaprayojana ca vaijayantīvibhūṣaṇam ity anena kṛṣṇasya parabrahmatvarūpatvābhivyaktyā kāvyasya parabrahmagocaratayā puṇḍrekṣubhakṣaṇavetanatulyaṃ muktirūpaṃ sūcyate, parabrahmasaśīlanasya muktiparyavasāyitvād iti | eva viśeṣaṇānāṃ sābhiprāyatvāt sābhiprāyaviśeṣaṇavinyāsarūpaḥ parikaro nāmārthālaṅkāraḥ | vande bṛndeti vallavīvallabham iti jayantī vaijayantīti ca padeṣu varṇasamatvād varṇasamatvarūpo ’nuprāsaḥ śabdālaṅkāraḥ | yamakatvaprayojakasthānaniyamābhāvād atra na kvāpi yamakaśaṅkā | vanda iti vartamānavyapadeśena prāg uktarītyā kaver bhagavadviṣayo ratibhāvo vyajyata iti bhāvadhvaniḥ | tena tathābhūtamahāpuruṣakṛtakāvyasya nāyakagauraveṇeva prabandhṛgauraveṇāpy upādeyatvaṃ vyajyata iti vastudhvaniḥ | tato netṛprabandhṛgauraveṇa phalotkarṣeṇaṃ cāsya kāvyasyānīdṛkkāvyāntarebhyo ’tiśayo vyajyata iti vyatirekālaṃkāradhvaniś ca | prasādādayo guṇāś cātra śloke yathāsaṃbhava draṣṭavyāḥ | bhūdevatākasya magaṇasyāmṛtabījasya vakārasya ca prathamaṃ prayogād gaṇavarṇaśuddhis suvyaktā | yady api vanda iti dhātur auttarāhāṇām oṣṭhyādiḥ | ‘‘bhvādau sa tu pavargīyādau bādhabandatī’’ *[n.i.]* iti bakiṣpatinā pavargatṛtīyādir uktaḥ | tathāpi yathā śāḍṛ ślāghāyām iti dhātor dhātupāṭhe ṭavargatṛtīyāntatve ’pi ḍalayor aikyāt loke rūpaśālī bhāgyaśālītyādau lāntaḥ prayogaḥ, evaṃ bavayor aikyāt antassthādir eva loke ’sya prayogaḥ | mādhavīyāyāṃ tu dhātuvṛttākya[?] dhātupāṭhe ’py antassthādir aṅgīkṛtaḥ | yad vā, kāvyārambhapratijñāparo ’yaṃ ślokaḥ | asmin pakṣe vande stuve | ‘‘vartamānasāmīpye’’ iti laṭ, stoṣya ity arthaḥ | vadi abhivādanastutyor iti dhātor iha stutyarthaḥ parigṛhyate | tathā ca tattaccaritamukhena bhagavaddivyaguṇānusakīrtanarūpatayā stutyātmakasya kāvyasyārambhaḥ pratijñāto bhavati | idañ ca padyaṃ yugmavipulā vṛttaṃ | pathyāvakram ity eke | ‘‘yasyāṃ las saptamo yugme sā yugmavipulā matā |’’ [VRK_2.25] ‘‘yujorjena saridbhartuḥ pathyāvakraṃ prakīrtitam |’’ [VRK_2.22] ity ubhayor api vicchitti viśeṣād iti || 1 ||
{1}: I have the following reading:
satyavāgārjavaratirupakurvanpriyaṃ vadan | bhajate yaḥ svayaṃ prītaḥ priyaḥ sa bhavati striyāḥ ||
yad ekaikaguṇaprānte śrāntā nigamavandinaḥ | yathāvad varṇane tasya kimutānye mitampacāḥ || 2 ||
nanu aparimeyānantakalyāṇaguṇasya bhagavato guṇakathanaṃ kathaṃ śakyam ity ākṣipati --- yad ekaiketi | nigamāḥ vedā eva vandinaḥ santamasantaṃ vā kam api guṇam avalambyāvaśya vandante stuvantīti vandinaḥ stutipāṭhakāḥ | vandati dhātos stutivṛtteḥ ‘‘āvaśyakādhamarṇyayor ṇiniḥ’’ [Pa_3,3.170] ity āvaśyakārthe ṇini pratyayaḥ | yad ekaikaguṇaprānte yasya bhagavataḥ ekasyaikasya guṇasyāgrabhāge | śrāntāḥ śramaṃ prāptāḥ | stotuṃ pravṛttā ekam api guṇaṃ kārtsnyena varṇayitum aśaknuvantaḥ prārambha eva pratihatā ity arthaḥ | tasya bhagavataḥ | yathāvat yathārham, varṇane samyag guṇavarṇane | anye mitampacāḥ kṣudrāḥ | kimuta te na śaktā iti kimu vaktavyam ity arthaḥ | ekaiketi vīpsāyāṃ dviruktiḥ ‘‘ekaṃ bahuvrīhivat’’ [Pa_8,1.9] iti bahuvrīhivadbhāvāt supo luk | yathāvad iti yathā śabdāt ‘‘tadarham’’ [Pa_5,1.117] ity arhārthaṃ vatipratyayaḥ | mitampacā ity atra ‘‘mitanakhe ca’’ [Pa_3,2.34] iti pacadhātoḥ khaś | ‘‘arurdviṣadajantasya mum’’ [Pa_6,3.67] iti mumāgamaḥ | ‘‘kadarye kṛpaṇakṣudrakimpacānamitaṃpacāḥ |’’ [AK_3,1.98] ity amaraḥ | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ | ‘‘nakir indra tvad uttaraḥ, viśvasmād rudra uttaraḥ’’ [RV_4,30.1] ityādiprakāreṇa indrādidevatāntareṣv asantam api guṇam āropya stavanaśīlā vandikalpā vedā api yasya guṇān stotuṃ pravṛttāḥ anādyanantakālapravāhe aparimitatattatkalpavṛttanānāvidhataccaritāvagamyotkarṣasya ekaikaguṇasya prānta eva śrāntāḥ, tāvac caritakoṭyaṃśamātrasyāpi kārtsnyena nibandhum aśakyatvāt | tasya nijanikhilaguṇavattayā pauṣkalyena varṇane manuṣyādiṣu santam api guṇaleśaṃ varṇayitum aśaktāḥ kṣudrāḥ śrāmyantīti kimu vaktavyam iti | atra kaveḥ kāvyārambhe svavinayāviṣkaraṇāya svāśaktipratipādane prastute sāmānyam abhihitam iti, aprastutāt sāmānyāt prastutaviśeṣapratīteḥ aprastutapraśaṃsā | kimuteti kaimutikanyāyopanyāsāt arthāpattiḥ | nigamavandina ity abhedāropāt rūpakam | eteṣāṃ ca alaṅkārāṇāṃ parasparānuprāṇitatvena sakaraḥ | yady api nigamavandina ity atra ‘‘upamitaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ’’ [Pa_2,1.56] iti sūtreṇa nigamā vandina iveti upamitasamāso ’pi sambhavati | tathāpi śramasambandhānurodhāt uttarapadārthapradhāno mayūr avyasakādisamāsa eveti rūpakanirṇayaḥ | upamitasamāse hi pūrvapadārthaprādhānyāt tatra mukhyārthaśramasambandho na syāt || 2 ||
śaktyā śaurikathāsvādaḥ sthāne mandadhiyām api | amṛtaṃ yadi labhyate kiṃ na gṛhyeta mānavaiḥ || 3 ||
imam ākṣepaṃ samādhatte --- śakyeti | mandadhiyām alpabuddhīnām api | śaktyā yāvacchakti | śaurikathāsvādaḥ śūrasya vasudevapitur apatyaṃ śauriḥ kṛṣṇaḥ, bāhvā derākṛtigaṇatvād iñpratyayaḥ ‘‘eko gotre’’ [Pa_4,1.93] iti niyamāt vyavahitāpatye ’pi paramaprakṛter eva pratyayaḥ | tasya kathāyā āsvādaḥ nibandhanarūpaḥ | sthāne ucitaḥ | ‘‘sthāne myāducite ’vyayam |’’ *[n.i.]* iti ratnamālā | tatra dṛṣṭāntam āha --- amṛtaṃ yadi labhyate, mānavaiḥ kiṃ na gṛhyeta nāsvādyeta āsvādyetaivety arthaḥ | ‘‘hetuhetumator liṅ’’ [Pa_3,3.156] | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ --- aśakye ’pi kārtsnyena bhagavadguṇavarṇane yāvatī buddheḥ prasaraṇaśaktis tāvad varṇanaṃ mandadhiyām api yuktam eva; na tu yāvad varṇanāśaktyā śakyāṃśo ’py upekṣaṇīyaḥ | na hi bahvamṛtaṃ mānavair na labhyata iti kiñcid api labdhaṃ tair nāsvādyata iti | yadvā evaṃ bhāvaḥ | yathā amṛtaṃ labhyate cen manuṣyā devārham idam iti svayaṃ na tyajanti, kin tu labdhamāsvād yanty eva; evaṃ mandabuddhitayā bhagavadguṇasākalyavarṇanānadhikṛtā api rasajñātiprājñakṛtyam idam iti nodāsate; kin tu śakyāṃśaṃ varṇayanty eva | ato mamāpi yathāmati bhagavaccaritavarṇanapravṛttau na kopi doṣa iti | atrāpi pūrvavat aprastutapraśaṃsā | upamānopameyayor bhagavaccaritāmṛtayos sāmānyadharmayoḥ kvacin nibandhanam anyatrāsvādanam iti bhinnayor bimbapratibimbabhāvena vākyadvayena nirdeśāt dṛṣṭāntaḥ | āsvādaśabdena nibandhanasya nigīryādhyavasānāt bhede abhedarūpātiśayoktiś ca alaṅkāraḥ | nigīryādhyavasānena ca tṛṣṇātirekaviṣayatvaṃ lakṣaṇāmūlaṃ vyaṅgyam | tac coktadṛṣṭāntasyopaskuruta iti guṇabhūtavyaṅgyabhedaḥ || 3 ||
vasudhāśrotraje tasmin vyāse ca hṛdayasthite | anye ’pi kavayaḥ kāmaṃ babhūvuranapatrapāḥ || 4 ||
vasudheti | vasudhāśrotraṃ valmīkam ‘‘vāmalūruś ca bhūśravaḥ’’ *[n.i.]* iti valmīkaparyāyeṣu ratnakośaḥ | ‘‘śrotraṃ hy etat pṛthivyāḥ yad valmīkaḥ’’ [TB_1,1,1,3.4] iti śrutiḥ | tatra jāto vasudhāśrotrajaḥ vālmīkiḥ tasmin | ‘‘saptamyāṃ janer ḍaḥ’’ [Pa_3,2.97] iti ḍapratyayaḥ | tasmin prasiddhe yasyādṛśam ādikāvyaṃ nirmama iti bhāvaḥ | vyāse ca mahābhāratanibandhari | hṛdayasthite manasi sphurati sati | anye ’pi tadubhayavyatiriktā api | kāmam atyartham | anapatrapāḥ rāmāyaṇaṃ mahābhārataṃ ca dṛṣṭvā svaprabandhān paśyantaḥ kathaṃ nāpahasiṣyantīti parebhyas trapayā rahitā eva | ‘‘mandākṣaṃ hīstrapā brīḍā lajjā sāpatrapānyataḥ’’ [AK_1,7.455] ity amaraḥ | kavayaḥ kāvyakṛto babhūvuḥ | vyāsavālmīkiprabandhau dṛṣṭvāpi tadanyeṣāṃ svayaṃ prabandhanirmāṇe pravṛttiḥ kevalaṃ nirapatrapakṛtyam eveti tayoḥ praśaṃsāparo ’yaṃ ślokaḥ | yadvā, prācāṃ mahākavīnāṃ prabandheṣu satsu svakīyaprabandhanirmāṇapravṛttāv anaucityaparihāreṇa svavinayāviṣkaraṇārtho ’yaṁ ślokaḥ | atra pakṣe anye ’pi madanye ’pīty arthaḥ | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ --- madanye ’pi hi kavayaḥ saty eva rāmāyaṇe bhārate ca yathā prabandhaṃ niramimata, evaṃ mayāpi nirmīyate | yathāmati nirmāṇe kāpatrapeti || 4 ||
sa kaviḥ kathyate sraṣṭā ramate yatra bhāratī | rasabhāvaguṇībhūtair alaṅkārair guṇodayaiḥ || 5 ||
sa iti | rasāḥ śṛṅgārādayaḥ, bhāvāḥ tattadrasocitāḥ vibhāvānubhāvasañcāriṇaḥ, guṇībhūtāni ‘‘agūḍhamaparasyāṅgaṃ vācyasiddhyaṅgamasphuṭam | sandigdhatulyaprādhānye kākvākṣiptam asundaram || ’’ [KP_45] ity uktarūpāṇi agūḍhatvāparāṅgatvādinimittair aprādhānyaṃ prāptāni vyaṅgyāni taiḥ | alaṅkārāḥ anuprāsopamādayaḥ taiḥ | guṇodayāḥ mādhuryādīnāṃ rasasamavetānāṃ guṇānāṃ tattadguṇocitavarṇasamāsaracanābhivyaktayaḥ taiḥ, prakāraiḥ upalakṣitā | bhāratī vāṇī | yatra ramate yasmin balād ākṛṣyamāṇatāṃ vinā svayam eva nirargalapravāharūpā vartate | saḥ sraṣṭā anyaiḥ kavibhir anullikhitasyārthasya pratibhayā niṣpādakaḥ | kaviḥ kathyate kavir iti vyapadiśyata iti prakṛto ’rthaḥ | api cātra rasabhāvāḥ rāgaprayuktā nayanādāv avalokanamandasmitādyanubhāvāḥ teṣāṃ guṇībhūtair upaskārakaiḥ tadvijṛmbhaṇahetubhūtair iti yāvat | alaṅkāraiḥ kaṭakakeyūrādibhiḥ | guṇaiḥ rūpayauvanādibhiḥ udayante nāyakadarśanenodgacchantīty udayāḥ dṛṣṭivikārādayaḥ taiś ca | upalakṣitā ‘‘ālambanaguṇāś caiva tac ceṣṭā tadalaṃkṛtiḥ | taṭasthāś ceti vijñeyaś caturthoddīpanakramaḥ |’’ *[n.i.]* nāyikāguṇālaṅkāraceṣṭānāṃ nāyakaratibhāvoddīpanahetutvam uktam | evaṃbhūtā bhāratī vāgdevatā, yatra ramate ratiṃ karoti | saḥ, sraṣṭā lokānāṃ nirmātā caturmukhaḥ kavir iti vyapadiśyate | ‘‘tene brahma hṛdā ya ādikavaye’’ [BhP_1,1.1] ity uktā ’prakṛto ’rthaḥ pratīyate | tena ca yathā sarasvatīvihārāspadībhūtaś caturmukhaḥ kavir vyapadiśyate; evam uktarūpaviśiṣṭakavitāśāly eva kavir vyapadiśyate ity upamālaṅkāro dhvanyate | anena tādṛśasya kavitvavidhānena tādṛśarasabhāvādicamatkārarahitam eva prabandhantaḥ parocchiṣṭopajīvinaś ca kavayo na bhavantīti vyajyate | teṣu ca kavitvaniṣedhobādhitaḥ san teṣām apahāsyatvādau viśeṣe paryavasyatīty abhimataviśeṣadyotanārthaniṣedhābhāsarūpa ākṣepālaṅkāro dhvanyate | anena svayaṃ kukavīnām upālambhena nāhan tathābhūta iti svakavitāprauḍhiprakaṭanāt pūrvaśloke vinayāviṣkaraṇena svakāvyasya phalgukartṛkatvaśaṅkā mā bhūd iti rasabhāvādibharitatayā sārataratvaṃ dyotyata iti śabdaśaktimūlakavastvalaṅkāradhvaniparamparānusandheyā || 5 ||
tadātve nūtanaṃ sarvamāyatyāṃ ca purātanam | na doṣāyaitad ubhayaṃ na guṇāya ca kalpate || 6 ||
atha svakāvye nūtanam ity eva ye doṣam udbhāvayeyur mandās tān pratyāha --- tadātva iti | sarvaṃ idānīntanaṃ prāktanaṃ cety akhilam prabandhajātam | tadātve tatkāle | nūtanam | āyatyām uttarakāle | purātanam | cakāro bhinnakramaḥ | ekatra dharmadvayasamuccayārthaḥ | ‘‘tatkālas tu tadātvaṃ syād uttaraḥ kāla āyatiḥ | ’’ [AK_2,7.990] ity amaraḥ | etad ubhayaṃ nūtanatvaṃ purātanatvaṃ ca | na doṣāya, na guṇāya ca kalpate | ‘‘kḷpisaṃpadyamāne ca vaktavyā’’ *[n.i.]* iti caturtho | yat nūtanatvena dūṣayituṃ iṣyate tad eva kālāntare purātanaṃ jāyate | yac ca purātanatvena upādātum iṣyate tad api svakāle nūtanam iti na te prabandheṣu hānopādānaprayojake, kin tu tattallakṣaṇavaikalyasākalye eveti bhāvaḥ || 6 ||
pravṛttām anaghe mārge pramādyantīm api kvacit | na vācam avamanyante nartakīm iva bhāvukāḥ || 7 ||
pravṛttām iti | aghaṃ pāpaṃ ‘‘aghaśabdo bhavet pāpe duḥkhavyasanayor api’’ *[n.i.]* iti ajayaḥ | tadviruddhaḥ anaghaḥ | adharmava[?]ñsamāsaḥ | aviruddhe tasmin sakalapāpakṣayakāriṇi | mārge bhagavaccaritasaṃgrathanarūpe pathi | pravṛttāṃ vācaṃ kavitām | kvacit sūkṣme bhagavaccaritarahasyādiviṣaye śabdārthaguṇadoṣādiviṣaye vā | pramādyantīm anavadhānām api | bhāvukāḥ bhāvanākṛto bhagavadbhaktāḥ | ‘‘bhuvo ’vakalkane’’ [DP_10.207] iti bhavater ṇijantāt ‘‘lapapata’’ *[n.i.]* ityādinā ukañcpratyayaḥ | avakalkanaṃ cintanam iti vyākhyātam nāvamanyante kvacit pramādamātreṇa na tantrāvamānaṃ kurvanti kin tu bhagavadviṣaya yathākathañcit abaddham api nikhilāghavidhvasanam iti parigṛhṇanty evety arthaḥ | ukta[?]va[ṃ?] śrībhāgavate | ‘‘sa vāgvisargo janatāghaviplavo yasmin pratiślokam avaddhavaty api | nāmānyanantasya yaśo ’ṅkitāni yat śṛṇvanti gāyanti gṛṇanti sādhavaḥ |’’ [BhP_1,5.11] iti | nartakīm ivety upamānanirdeśaḥ | atra pakṣe anaghe vigalitavedyāntaranāṭyarasāsvādanena duḥkhavirodhini | mārge mārgo deśīti dvidhā nṛttam uktaṃ saṅgītaśāstreṣu | tatra mārgākhye nṛtte | pravṛttāṃ nartakīm iva mārganṛtte kṛtaśikṣāṃ vanitām iva | ‘‘nartakaḥ surabhiḥ prokto mārganṛtte kṛtaśramaḥ |’’ *[n.i.]* iti saṅgītaratnākaraḥ | ‘‘śilpini ṣvun’’ [Pa_3,1.145] iti ṣvunpratyaye ‘‘ṣidgaurādibhyaś ca’’ [Pa_4,1.41] iti ṇīṣ | bhāvukāḥ tattadbhāvaceṣṭāviśeṣajñāḥ | ‘‘bhāvā vinaiva ceṣṭābhir na dṛśyante kadācana | tasmāc ceṣṭāviśeṣajñā bhāvukā rasikāḥ smṛtāḥ ||’’ [BP_6] iti śāradātanayaḥ || atra mārga iti bhāvukā iti ca bhinnārthaśabdānāṃ yugapad udīraṇāt śleṣaḥ | śliṣṭapadopāttayor arthayor upamāyāṃ sāmānyadharmatvasiddhyartham abhedāddhyavasāyāttanmūlātiśayoktiś ca | tadanuprāṇitaś ca nartakīm iveti upamālaṅkāraḥ || 7 ||
vihāya tad ahaṃ vrīḍāṃ vyāsavedārṇavāmṛtam | vakṣye vibudhajīvātuṃ vasudevasutodayam || 8 ||
vihāyeti | tat tasmād uktahetoḥ | ahaṃ vrīḍāṃ yatkiñcid avalambyāpahasiṣyantīti trapam | vihāya | vyāsavedārṇavāmṛtaṃ vyāsavedo mahābhārataṃ tad evārṇavaḥ tasyāmṛtaṃ amṛtavat sārabhūtam | vibudhā vidvāṃsaḥ ta eva vibudhā devāḥ iti śliṣṭarūpakam | teṣāṃ jīvātuṃ bhaktaṃ jīvanauṣadhaṃ ca | devānāṃ bhaktam amṛtam, prabandho viduṣām | hṛdayāpy āyanatvād upacārāt | ‘‘jīvātur jīvite bhakte jīvātur jīvanauṣadham |’’ *[n.i.]* iti viśvaḥ | vasudevasutasya kṛṣṇasya udayam abhyudayam | vakṣye abhidhāsye varṇayiṣya ity arthaḥ | bruvo va[?]virātmanepadī | atra vyāsavedārṇavāmṛtam iti vibudhajīvātum iti ca śliṣṭāśliṣṭaśabdanibandhanarūpakadvayasaṅkaraḥ || 8 ||
krīḍātūlikayā svasmin kṛpārūṣitayā svayam | eko viśvam idaṃ citraṃ vibhuḥ śrīmān ajījanat || 9 ||
atha ‘‘yadorvaṃśaṃ naraḥ śrutvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate | yatrāvatīrṇaṃ kṛṣṇākhyaṃ pūrṇaṃ brahma narākṛti ||’’ [VP_4,11.4] {1} iti yaduvaṃśaśravaṇasya paramapāvanatvasmaraṇāt kiñcid yaduvaṃśaparamparāvarṇanapūrvakaṃ bhagavaccaritavivakṣayā prathamaṃ yaduvaṃśakūṭasthasya candramasaḥ puruṣasūktaprakriyayā puruṣottamasya mānasād utpattyabhidhitsayā tadupodghātatvena bhagavatā puruṣottamena sarvam idaṃ jagatsṛṣṭam ity arthaṃ tāvad āha --- krīḍeti | vibhuḥ nikhilajagatsṛṣṭipālanasahārānukūlavividhaśaktiyogāt niratiśayavaibhavaḥ | śrīmān nityayoge matup | anapāyinyā śrīmahālakṣmyā nityayuktaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | ekaḥ sahāyāntaranirapekṣa eva | idaṃ viśvaṃ jagat samastaṃ vā | ‘‘viśva samastajagatoḥ’’ *[n.i.]* iti viśvaḥ, citram āścaryabhūtaṃ tad eva citram ālekhyam iti śliṣṭarūpakam | ‘‘ālekhyāścaryayoś citram |’’ [AK_3,3.718] ity amaraḥ | kṛpārūṣitayā dayārasena digdhayā | krīḍātūlikayā svalīlaiva tūlikā ālekhyakūrcis tayā | svayaṃ svatantreṇa ātmanā | svasminn ātmany adhikaraṇe | ajījanat janayāmāsa | janidhātor ṇici luṅo rūpaṃ | bhūtasāmānyavivakṣayā ca luṅprayogaḥ | atra svayaṃ svasminn iti viśeṣaṇadvayena bhagavataṃ prapañcanimittopādānobhayavidhakāraṇatvaṃ darśitam | tasya samābhyadhikarāhityaṃ vibhāvayituṃ anekakoṭibrahmāṇḍaghaṭitasyāsya prapañcasya nirmāṇaṃ sahāyāntaranair apekṣya darśitaṃ ekaṃ iti | etāvat prapañcanirmāṇe asahāyasya kartṛtve asaṃbhāvanāṃ vyāvartayituṃ sarvaśaktimayatvaṃ darśitaṃ vibhur iti | prakaraṇopapadādisaṅkocarahitaṃ hi vibhupadaṃ tasya niratiśayaṃ vaibhavaṃ prakhyāpayati | nityāvāptasamastakāmasya bhagavataḥ prapañcanirmāṇaṃ prayojanābhāvād anupapannam iti śaṅkāṃ vārayitum uktaṃ krīḍātūlikayeti | yathā sārvabhaumo ’vāptasakalakāmo ’pi līlayā svayaṃ kantukādikaṃ karoti tathā bhagavān api prapañcabhityāśayaḥ | nanu svasya līlety etāvatā yadi jīvarāśīn narakagarbhavāsādiduḥkhapaṅke nimajjayati, tarhi niṣkaruṇa eva syāt | tataś cāsya nikhilaheyapratyanīkasamastakalyāṇaguṇaparipūrṇatvahānir iti śaṅkāṃ vārayitum uktaṃ kṛpārūṣitayeti | na kevalaṃ līlātūlikayā jagannirmāti ; kin tu kṛpārūṣitayā | ata eva muktyupāyapratipādakā api vedabhāgā upadiṣṭāḥ | tadupayogīni karmāṇi | tannirvartakāni ca vrīhyādīni sṛṣṭāni | na hi jīveṣu nirvyājaniratiśayakṛpārāhitye nityatṛptaḥ svayaṃ muktyupāyakarmādīny upadiśati | tathā nirvyājakṛpālutve ’pi nirhetukam eva na mocayati | svalīlāyās sarvathaiva virodhaprasaṅgāt | mocakasyāpi bhagavato muktyupāyadharmasāpekṣatvāt na vaiṣamyanair ghṛṇye, ‘‘vaiṣamyanair ghṛṇye na sāpekṣatvāt’’ [BS_2,1.34] iti nyāyād iti bhāvaḥ | nanv eva vidho jagannirmātā puruṣottama evety atra kiṃ pramāṇam ity ākāṅkṣāyāṃ puruṣasūktaṃ tatra pramāṇaṃ vibhāvayitum uktaṃ śrīmān iti | puruṣottama eva khalu śriyaḥ patitvena prasiddhaḥ | puruṣasūktānantarānuvāke ca tadekavākyatāpanna ‘‘hrīś ca te lakṣmīś ca patnyau’’ [TA_3,13.2] iti prakṛte jagannirmātari puruṣe śriyaḥ patitvaṃ nibaddham | ataḥ puruṣottama eva jagannirmātā siddhyatīty abhiprāyaḥ | itthaṃ vicintyāḥ sarvatra bhāvāḥ santi pade pade | kavitārkikasiṃhasya kāvyeṣu laliteṣv api | tathāpi vistarāpatter naivam agraṃ prapañcyate | kāvyavyākhyākṛtāṃ rītiḥ prācām evānugamyate || evaṃ viśeṣaṇānāṃ viśeṣyasya ca sābhiprāyatvāt parikaraparikarāṅkurālaṅkārau | viśeṣaṇasābhiprāyatvaṃ parikaraḥ, viśeṣyasābhiprāyatvaṃ parikarāṃkura iti tayor bhedaḥ | krīḍātūlikayeti rūpakam | rūpaṇānvayānusārataś ca krīḍāyās tūlikātvāropeṇa kṛpāyā rūṣikāyā rāgadravyatvāropo gamyata ity ekadeśavṛttirūpakālaṅkāraḥ | anena rūpakeṇotthāpitaṃ ca citraśabde śliṣṭarūpakam iti tenāsya sakaraḥ || 9 ||

{1}: This passage is also found in Aśvaghoṣa’s Buddhacarita (8.13): idaṃ puraṃ tena vivarjitaṃ vanaṃ vanaṃ ca tattena samanvitaṃ puram | na śobhate tena hi no vinā puraṃ marutvatā vṛtravadhe yathā divam ||
yaśaḥprasūnasurabhir yadusantānapādapaḥ | babhūva vibudhaprītyai bahuśākhaḥ kṣamātale || 26 ||
yaśa iti | yaśāṃsyeva prasūnāni tais surabhiḥ sugandhiḥ | prasavagandheneva yaśaḥprasaraṇena dūre ’pi khyāpyamānatvāt sugandhitvāropaḥ | bahuśākhaḥ bahvyaḥ śākhāḥ vedaprabhedā yasya sa tathoktaḥ anekavedaśākhādhyāyīti yāvat | pādapapakṣe bahuviṭapaḥ | yadusantānapādapaḥ yadur eva santānākhyaḥ suradrumaviśeṣaḥ, mahāvadānyatvāt | kṣamātale bhūtale | talaśabdaḥ svarūpavācī | ‘‘talaṃ svarūpādharayoḥ’’ *[n.i.]* iti viśvaḥ | vibudhaprītyai viduṣāṃ prītyai | babhūva | prasiddho hi santānapādapo divi vibudhānāṃ devānāṃ prītyai bhavati | ayaṃ tu bhuvi vibudhānāṃ prītyai babhūveti viśeṣa iti bhāvaḥ | yadvā yaduvaṃśaparatvenāyaṃ śloko yojyaḥ | tatra pakṣe, yadusantāna eva santānapādapa iti santānapade śleṣaḥ bahuśākha iti ca | tatra vṛṣṇyandhakabhojādyanekāvāntarasantatiprabheda ity arthaḥ, śākhāśabdasyopacārāt avāntarasantatiṣu vṛtteḥ | yaśaḥprasūnety atra rūpakasamāsaḥ, saurabhānuguṇyāt | tadutthāpitaṃ ca vibudhādiśabdaiḥ śliṣṭarūpakam iti śliṣṭāśliṣṭarūpakadvayasaṅkaraḥ || 26 ||
vaṃśe samabhavat tasya vasudevaḥ kṣitīśvaraḥ | janakaḥ prāgbhave yo ’bhūd devadānavayūthayoḥ || 27 ||
vaṃśa iti | tasya yadoḥ | vaṃśe | vasudevaḥ kṣitīśvaraḥ vasudevākhyo rājā | samabhavat saṃbhūtaḥ | yaḥ | prāgbhave pūrvajanmani | devadānavayūthayoḥ devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca samūhayoḥ | ‘‘yūthaṃ tiryaksamūhe ’pi bṛndamātre ’pi bhāṣitam |’’ *[n.i.]* iti viśvaḥ | janako ’bhūt pitā babhūva | purā kila kāśyapaḥ surabher aditeś ca svapatnyor anurodhena varuṇasya yajñagavīr hṛtvā brahmaṇaś śāpāt rohiṇīdevakīrūpābhyāṃ tābhyāṃ saha svayaṃ vasudevarūpeṇa manuṣyaloke jāta iti harivaṃśe kathā || 27 ||
ānakānāṃ ca divyānāṃ dundubhīnāṃ ca nisvanaiḥ | saha jātaṃ yam ācakhyur ākhyayānakadundubhim || 28 ||
ānakānām iti | ānakānāṃ paṭahānām | dundubhīnāṃ bherīṇāṃ ca | ‘‘ānakaḥ paṭaho ’strī syād bherī strī dundubhiḥ pumān’’ [AK_1,7.19-20] {1} ity amaraḥ | nisvanaiḥ dhvanibhiḥ | saha jātam | yaṃ vasudevam | ākhyayā nāmnā | ānakadundubhim, ācakhyuḥ akathayan | vṛddhā iti śeṣaḥ || 28 ||
{1}: I have a different order: (1.7.419) syād yaśaḥpaṭaho ḍhakkā bherī strī dundubhiḥ pumān (1.7.420) ānakaḥ paṭaho 'strī syāt koṇo vīṇādi vādanam
tena nirmalasatvena vinivṛttarajastamāḥ | jagatī śāntamoheva dharmocchvāsavatī babhau || 29 ||
teneti | nirmalaṃ akalaṅkaṃ satvaṃ satvaguṇo yasya tena | tena vasudevena hetunā | vinivṛttarajastamāḥ apagatarajastamoguṇā | tena kartrā vinivartitarajastamoguṇeti vā | ata eva, dharmocchvāsavatī dharmābhivṛddhimatī | jagatī bhūmiḥ | ‘‘jagatī viṣṭape mahyām’’ *[n.i.]* iti viśvaḥ | śāntamoheva tataḥ pūrvaṃ mūrchām anubhūya tadānīm apagatamūrcheva | babhau | mūrchito hi stabdhaś vāso mūrchātyaye saty ucchvasitīti bhāvaḥ || 29 ||
sa viṣṇur iva lokāṇāṃ tapanas tejasām iva | samudra iva ratnānāṃ satām ekāśrayo ’bhavat || 30 ||
sa iti | sa vasudevaḥ | lokānāṃ viṣṇur iva | tejasāṃ tapana iva | ratnānāṃ samudra iva ca | satāṃ sajjanānām | ekaḥ āśrayaḥ abhavat | sakalasādhujanopajīvyo ’bhavad ity arthaḥ | mālopamālaṃkāraḥ || 30 ||
prakhyātavibhave patnyau tasya pūrvaṃ prajāpateḥ | rohiṇīdevakīrūpe manuṣyatve babhūvatuḥ || 31 ||
prakhyāteti | pūrvaṃ prajāpateḥ kāśyapaprajāpatirūpasya | tasya | prakhyātavibhave prasiddhamāhātmye | patnyau surabhir aditiś cety ubhe bhārye | manuṣyatve manuṣyabhāve | rohiṇīdevakīrūpe | babhūvatuḥ || 31 ||
akṣudragatiśālinyos tayor anyonyasaktayoḥ | aikarasyam abhūt patyā gaṅgāyamunayor iva || 32 ||
akṣudreti | akṣudragatiśālinyoḥ akrūrabuddhiśālinyoḥ | śālaṃ gatāv iti dhātos tācchīliko ṇiniḥ | nadīpakṣe analpapravāhagamanabhājor ity arthaḥ | ‘‘kṣudras syād adhamakrūrakṛpaṇālpeṣu vācyavat |’’ *[n.i.]* iti viśvaḥ | ‘‘gatis tu gamane mārge daśāyāṃ buddhyupāyayoḥ’’ *[n.i.]* iti ratnamālā | anyonyasaktayoḥ anyonyānuraktayoḥ, nadīpakṣe anyonyasaṃsṛṣṭayoḥ | tayoḥ devakīrohiṇyoḥ | gaṅgāyamunayor iva | patyā vasudevena saha | aikarasyaṃ tulyarāgatvaṃ abhūt | nadīpakṣe samudreṇa saha ekodakatvaṃ lavaṇarasaikyaṃ vā | ‘‘raso gandhe rasāsvāde tiktādau viṣarāgayoḥ | śṛṅgārādau drave vīrye dehadhātvam[?]pārade |’’ iti viśvaḥ | upamālaṃkāraḥ || 32 ||
sa tābhyām anurūpābhyāṃ samatuṣyat sameyivān | vyaktihetur abhūd yena saparyaṅkasya śārṅgiṇaḥ || 33 ||
sa iti | sa vasudevaḥ | anurūpābhyāṃ śīlavṛttādibhiḥ susadṛśībhyām | tābhyāṃ rohiṇīdevakībhyām | sameyivān sametas san | ‘‘upeyivān anāśvān’’ [Pa_3,2.109] ity atra upasargagrahaṇasyātantratvāt sampūrvasyāpīṇaḥ kvasu nipātaḥ | samatuṣyat santuṣṭo ’bhavat | yena rohiṇīdevakīsamavāyena | saparyaṅkasya śeṣaparyaṅkasahitasya | śārṅgiṇaḥ śeṣaśāyinaḥ | vyaktihetuḥ prādurbhāve hetuḥ | abhūt || 33 ||
alipsata na sāmrājyaṃ so ’rthakāmaparāṅmukhaḥ | yadṛcchāgatam aiśvaryam ānṛṇyarucir anvabhūt || 34 ||
alipsateti | arthakāmaparāṅmukhaḥ arthakāmayoḥ puruṣārthayor vimukhaḥ, dharmamokṣaparatvāt | sa vasudevaḥ | sāmrājyaṃ samrājo maṇḍaleśvarasya bhāvaṃ rājyādhipatyam | nālipsata labdhuṃ naicchat | ‘‘yeneṣṭaṃ rājasūyena maṇḍalasyeśvaraś ca yaḥ | śāsti yaścājñayā rājñaḥ sa samrāḍ’’ [AK_2,7.937-938] ity amaraḥ | ānṛṇyaruciḥ ‘‘yajñena devebhyaḥ prajayā pitṛbhyaḥ’’ [TS_6,3,10.5] iti śrautam ṛṇaṃ nāsti yasya so ’nṛṇaḥ tasya bhāva āmṛṇyaṃ tasmin rucir yasya tathābhūtas san | yadṛcchāgataṃ aniyamenāgataṃ ayatnena daivāl labdham | aiśvaryam | anvabhūt abhuṅkta | ‘‘vadṛcchā ’niyamo bhavet |’’ *[n.i.]* iti vaijayantī || 34 ||
kayācid aśarīriṇyā vācā vyavasitāyatiḥ | devakīṃ vasudevaṃ ca kaṃsaḥ kārām ayojayat || 35 ||*
kayācid iti | aśarīriṇyā śarīrahitayā | kayācit ‘‘yāmenāṃ vahase mūḍha saha bhartrā rathe sthitām | asyās tavāṣṭamo garbhaḥ prāṇān apahariṣyati |’’ [VP_5,1.8] ity evaṃrūpayā | vācā | vyavasitāyatiḥ vyavasitāgāmikālaḥ niścitabhaviṣyadvṛttānta iti yāvat | ‘‘āyatiḥ syād dīrghatāyāṃ prabhāvāgāmikālayoḥ |’’ iti ratnamālā | evaṃbhūtaḥ, kaṃsaḥ | devakīṃ asyāḥ patiṃ vasudevaṃ ca | kārāṃ bandhanāgāram | ayojayat agamayat | yujer gatyarthavivakṣāyāṃ gati buddhītyādinā dvikarmakatvam || 35 ||
* Another reading: kayācid aśarīriṇyā vācā vyavasitāyatiḥ | devakīṃ patim apy asyāḥ kaṃsaḥ kārām ayojayat ||
sa kālātibalaḥ kaṃsaḥ kālanemir anehasā | sarvadaiteyasatvānāṃ samāhāra ivoditaḥ || 36 ||*
sa iti | sa kaṃsaḥ | kālād antakād atibalaḥ | anehasā kālena | ‘‘kālo diṣṭo ’py anehāpi’’ [AK_1,4.251] ity amaraḥ | sarvadaiteyasatvānāṃ akhiladaityaparākramāṇām | samāhāraḥ samuccaya iva | uditaḥ kālanemiḥ khalu | kālanemyākhyaḥ prāgbhagavatā hato mahāsura eva kaṃsarūpeṇa nikhilāsurabalasamāhāra ivāvirbhūta ity arthaḥ | ato ’sminn īdṛśī svasṛbandhanādinṛśaṃsateti bhāvaḥ || 36 ||
* Another reading: sa khalv atibalaḥ kālāt kālanemir anehasā | sarvadaiteyasatvānāṃ samāhāra ivotthitaḥ ||
etāsminn antare devī merumadhyam upeyuṣaḥ | prajāpatimukhān devān prāha sāgaramekhalā || 37 ||
etasminn iti | etasminn antare avasare | sāgaramekhalā samudraraśanā | devī dharitrī | merumadhyam | upeyuṣaḥ prāptavataḥ | prajāpatimukhān caturmukhaprabhṛtīn | devān | prāha vakṣyamāṇam uvāca | ‘‘āhety uvācārthe vibhaktipratirūpakam avyayam |’’ *[n.i.]* iti śākaṭāyanaḥ | tatra ‘‘kugatiprādayaḥ |’’ [Pa_2,2.18] iti samāsaḥ | ato nede brūño laṭi rūpam iti na smaśabdāpekṣā || 37 ||
viditaṃ bhavatāṃ devā viśvarūpeṇa viṣṇunā | mahīyān dharmaśīleṣu bhāro yat tan niveśitaḥ || 38 ||*
viditam iti | he devāḥ | bhavatāṃ viditaṃ bhavadbhir avagamyate tat | viśvarūpeṇa viśvavigraheṇa | viṣṇunā | mahīyān bhāraḥ parvatādibhārebhyo ’tiśayena mahān mahīyān bhāraḥ | dharmaśīleṣu dharmasvabhāveṣu dhārmikeṣu | niveśita iti yat, tat bhavatāṃ viditam iti pūrveṇa sambandhaḥ | yatpadasyottaravākyagatatvāt pūrvavākye tatpadāprayogaḥ | yat tad ity atra tacchabdas tu na yatpadapratinirdeśarūpaḥ | kintu ‘‘gobhir vipraiś ca vedaiś ca satībhis satyavādibhiḥ | dātṛbhir dharmaśīlaiś ca saptabhir dhāryate mahī |’’ *[n.i.]* ityādiprasiddhiparāmarśī | yatpadasannihitasya tacchabdasyānuvādakoṭiniveśena prasiddhiparāmarśakatvaniyamāt | tad uktaṃ kāvyaprakāśikāyām | ‘‘yacchabdasya nikaṭe sthitaḥ tacchabdaḥ prasiddhiṃ parāmarśayati’’ *[n.i.]* iti | viditam ity atra ‘‘matibuddhipūjārthebhyaś ca’’ [Pa_3,2.188] iti vartamāne ktaḥ | ‘‘ktasya ca vartamāne |’’ [Pa_2,3.67] iti tadyogena bhavatām iti ṣaṣṭhī | ‘‘dvivacanavibhajyopapade tarab īyasunau |’’ [Pa_5,3.57] iti mahacchabdādīyasunpratyayaḥ | yady apy atra vibhajyam upapadaṃ nopāttam | tathāpi buddhisthaṃ pratiyoginam apekṣyātiśayavivakṣāyāṃ pratyayaḥ | ‘‘bauddhapratiyogyapekṣāyām apy ātiśāyinikāḥ’’ [KAS_5,2.60] iti vāmanokteḥ || 38 ||
* Another reading: viditaṃ bhavatāṃ yat tad viśvarūpeṇa viṣṇunā | mahīyān dharmaśīleṣu mama bhāro niveśitaḥ ||
adharmanighnair adhunā dharmasetuvibhedakaiḥ | asaṅkhyair adbhutais tuṅgaiḥ kramye rākṣasaparvataiḥ || 39 ||*
adharmeti | adhunā idānīm | adharmanighnaiḥ adharmādhīnaiḥ tatpreritaiḥ | ata eva, dharmasetuvibhedakaiḥ dharmamaryādābhañjakaiḥ | asaṃkhyaiḥ saṃkhyārahitaiḥ niṣparipanthitayā saṃkhyena yuddhena rahitair vā | ‘‘ekatvādau vicāre ca saṃkhyā saṃkhyaṃ tu saṃyuge |’’ *[n.i.]* iti ratnamālā | tuṅgaiḥ śauryeṇonnataiḥ | adbhutaiḥ āścaryabhūtaiḥ | rākṣasaparvataiḥ | kramye krāntā bhavāmi | krameḥ karmaṇi laḍ uttamapuruṣaḥ | yady api dharmasetuvibhedakair ity atra ṣaṣṭhīsamāsasya ‘‘kartari ca’’ [Pa_2,2.16] iti pratiṣedho ’sti, tathāpi yājakāder ākṛtigaṇatvena kecid īdṛśaprayogaṃ samarthayante | anye tu samāsaniṣedhaḥ kṛdyogalakṣaṇaṣaṣṭhīviṣaya iti śeṣaṣaṣṭhyā samāsam upapādayanti | ṣaṣṭhīsamāsapratiṣedhakāṇḍārambhaṃ svaraviṣaya iti sunītikīrtyākhyavṛttikāraḥ || 39 ||
* Another reading: adharmanighnair adhunā dharmasetuvibhedakaiḥ | asaṅkhyair aham ākramyate tuṅgair āsuraparvataiḥ ||
ata ālocitajagaddhitais suragaṇais svayam | na patāmi na bhidye ca yathāhaṃ kriyatāṃ tathā || 40 ||*
ata iti | ataḥ asmād dhetoḥ | ālocitajagaddhitaiḥ cintitalokahitaiḥ | suragaṇaiḥ | ahaṃ yathā atibhārān na patāmi, na ca bhidye svayam eva bhinnā ca na bhavāmi | karmakartari yakpratyayaḥ | tathā kriyatām iti prārthanāyāṃ loṭ || 40 ||
* Another reading: ataḥ suragaṇaiḥ sārdham ālocitajagaddhitaiḥ | na patāmi na bhidye ca yathāhaṃ kriyatāṃ tathā ||
iti te bhūtadhāriṇyā nisṛṣṭārthā divaukasaḥ | avidus tatpriyasyaiva tadbhāraharaṇaṃ kṣamam || 41 ||
itīti | bhūtadhāriṇyā dharitryā | iti uktaprakāreṇa | nisṛṣṭārthāḥ nyastārthā niveditaprayojanāḥ | te divaukaso devāḥ | tatpriyasya tasyā dharitryāḥ priyasya nārāyaṇasyaiva | tadbhāraharaṇam | kṣamaṃ śakyam | aviduḥ acintayan | ‘‘vida jñāne’’ [DP_2.59] iti dhātor laṭ | ‘‘sijabhyastavidibhyaś ca’’ [Pa_3,4.109] iti jher jusādeśaḥ || 41 ||
puraskṛtya jagaddhātrīṃ manaso ’pi puraḥsarāḥ | dugdhodadhiśayaṃ devaṃ dūram etyābhituṣṭuvuḥ || 42 ||
puraskṛtyeti | devāḥ, jagaddhātrīṃ bhūmim | puraskṛtya | manaso mānasasyāpi | puras sarāḥ tato ’pi raṃhasvinaḥ santaḥ | dūraṃ etya kṣīrābdher uttarataṭaparyantaṃ gatvā | dugdhodadhiśayaṃ kṣīrābdhau śayānam | devaṃ puruṣottamam | abhituṣṭuvuḥ abhito nānāvidhaiḥ stuvanti sma || 42 ||
trivedīmadhyadīptāya tridhāmne pañcahetaye | varadāya namas tubhyaṃ bāhyāntarahavir bhuje || 43 ||
trivedīti | trayāṇāṃ vedānāṃ samāhāraḥ trivedī tasyā madhye dīptāya pratipādyatayā prakāśamānāya | ‘‘matibuddhipūjārthebhyaś ca’’ [Pa_3,2.188] iti cakārād vartamāne ktaḥ | pañcahetaye pañca hetayaḥ śaṅkhacakragadākhaṅgaśārṅgarūpāṇy āyudhāni yasya tasmai | varadāya bhaktānām īpsitapradāya | bāhyāntarahavir bhuje bāhya haviḥ carupuroḍāśasānnāyyādi, āntaraṃ prapadanākhye yajane homadravyaṃ jīvarūpaṃ haviḥ, tadubhaya bhuṅkta iti tathoktaḥ, evaṃbhūtāya | tridhāmne puruṣottamāya | tubhyaṃ namaḥ | trīṇi dhāmāni dugdhāmbudhiravimaṇḍalaparamapadarūpāṇi sthānāny asyeti tridhāmaśabdo bhagavadvācī | ‘‘tridhāmā keśave ’nale’’ *[n.i.]* iti vaijayantī | tataś ca tridhāmna ity anena agnir iti pratīyate, tato vailakṣaṇyaparāṇi viśeṣaṇāni | sa hi paśusomayoḥ uttarasyām uttaravedyāṃ madhye dīpyate | saptahetiś ca | ‘‘kālī karālī ca manojavā ca’’ [MU_1,2.4] ityādinā jvālāsaptakaśruteḥ | ‘‘raver arciś ca śastrañ ca vahnijvālā ca hetayaḥ |’’ [AK_3,3.488] ity amaraḥ | śrīmātrapadaś ca, ‘‘śriyam icched dhutāśanāt |’’ *[n.i.]* iti smṛteḥ | bāhyam eva ca havir bhuṅkta iti | eva prakaraṇāt puruṣottamapareṇāpi viśeṣyeṇāprakṛte pāvake pratyāyyamāve viśeṣaṇabalāt tasya tato vailakṣaṇyaṃ vyajyata iti śabdaśaktimūlo vyatirekālaṅkāradhvaniḥ || 43 ||
ananyādhīnamahimā svādhīnaparavaibhavaḥ | dayādhīnavihāras tvaṃ praṇatān paripāhi naḥ || 44 ||
ananyeti | anyasminn adhīno ’nyādhīnaḥ, vaiṣayikādhikaraṇe saptamī | saptamīti yogavibhāgāt samāsaḥ | ‘‘adhīno nighna āyattaḥ’’ [AK_3,1.34] ity amaraḥ | yad vā anyasmin svāminyadhīti vigrahe ‘‘saptamī śauṇḍaiḥ’’ [Pa_2,1.40] iti samāsaḥ | adhiśabdasya śauṇḍādiṣu pāṭhāt | adhyuttarapadatvāt ‘‘aṣaḍakṣāśitaṅgvalaṅkarmālampuruṣādhyuttarapadāt khaḥ |’’ [Pa_5,4.7] iti svārthe khapratyayaḥ | ubhayathāpi paratantra ity arthaḥ | iyam eva svādhīnādipadeṣv api vyākhyā | anyādhīno na bhavatīty ananyādhīnaḥ, tādṛśo mahimā yasya | svādhīnaṃ pareṣāṃ brahmādīnāṃ vaibhavaṃ yasya | dayādhīno vihāro rāvaṇavadhādirūpo vyāpāraḥ yasya | evaṃbhūtaḥ, tvam | praṇatān | naḥ asmān | paripāhi parito rakṣa | praṇatān api na nirdayo rakṣatīty ata uktaṃ dayādhīneti | kasādinigraheṇa lokarakṣaṇe bhagavata eva prārthanāyāṃ hetugarbhaviśeṣaṇa svādhīneti | anyaiḥ kasādinigrahaḥ kriyate ced api tvatprasādalabhyāṃ śaktim apekṣya kartavyaḥ | ato bhikṣitabhikṣaṇaṃ vihāya ‘‘ekāhād vā teṣāṃ samatvāt syāt |’’ [MS_8,3.11] iti nyāyena tvam eva prārthanīyo nānya ity abhiprāyaḥ | yadi bhagavadvaibhavam apy anyādhīnaṃ syāt tarhi tenaiva nyāyena sa eva prārthanīyo bhavet na ca tathety āśayenoktam ananyādhīneti || 44 ||
sa bhavān guṇaratnaughair dīpyamāno dayāmbudhiḥ | tanoti vyūhavibhavais taraṅgair iva tāṇḍavam || 45 ||
sa iti | guṇāḥ jñānaśaktibalaiśvaryādaya eva ratnāni teṣām oghaiḥ samūhaiḥ | dīpyamānaḥ prakāśamānaḥ | dayāmbudhiḥ kṛpāśrayaḥ samudra iva vipulādhāraḥ, samudrarūpo vā | bhavān | vyūhavibhavaiḥ vyūhāḥ vāsudevasaṅkarṣaṇapradyumnāniruddhāḥ, vibhavāḥ raghunāthādyavatārāḥ taiḥ | taraṅgaiḥ ūrmibhir iva | tāṇḍavaṃ naṭanaṃ tathā tathābhinayanam | samudrapakṣe tu ullalanam | tanoti | bhavacchabdaprayogeṇa yuṣmadupapadasya sthānino ’py abhāvāt ‘‘śeṣe prathamaḥ’’ [Pa_1,4.108] iti prathamapuruṣanirdeśaḥ | anena dayālos tava bhaktarakṣaṇāyāvatārādiparigrahaḥ svābhāvika iti idānīm api rakṣaṇāyāvataritavyam iti vyajyate || 45 ||
tvadekavyañjitair ādau tvadanyeṣv anidaṃparaiḥ | nigamair anigamyaṃ tvāṃ kaḥ paricchettum arhati || 46 ||
tvadeketi | ādau mahāsargādau | tvadekavyañjitaiḥ ekena vyañjitā ekavyañjitāḥ tvayā ekavyañjitā iti śivabhāgavatavat samāsaḥ | anyathā tvadekaśabdayoḥ prathamaṃ samāse pūrvakālaikasarvajaratpurāṇetyādinā ekaśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ syāt | mahāsargādau bhagavatā pūrvapūrvakalpapravṛttānupūrvīviśiṣṭāḥ vedāḥ tathaivāviṣkṛtā iti śāstramaryādā | tvadanyeṣu | anidaṃparaiḥ idaṃ paraṃ mukhyaṃ pratipādyatvena pradhānaṃ yeṣāṃ te idaṃparāḥ, atathābhūtaiḥ tvadvyatirikteṣu tātparyaparyavasānarahitair ity arthaḥ | ‘‘puraṃ dūrānyamukhyeṣu‘‘ *[n.i.]* iti ratnamālā | itthaṃbhūtaiḥ, nigamaiḥ vedaiḥ | anigamyaṃ aniśceyam | tvām | kaḥ | paricchettuṃ arhati | ‘‘nigamo niścaye puryāṃ pathi vede vaṇikpathe’’ *[n.i.]* iti ratnamālā | yo hy etāvadbhir vedarāśibhis tadekatātparyaiḥ pratipādyamāno ’pi na samyak paricchidyate, tam anyaḥ paricchettuṃ na śaknotīti kim u vaktavyam iti vyañjayituṃ tvadanyeṣv anidaṃparair ity uktam | yadi vedānāṃ kaścid anyo vaktā syāt tadā vaktṛdoṣasaṃbhavāt tenaiva teṣāṃ nirṇayāśaktatvam anyathāsiddhaṃ na prameyagauravādity āśaṅkyoktaṃ tvadekavyañjitair iti || 36 ||
amitasya mahimnas te prayātuṃ pāram icchatām | vitathā vedapānthānāṃ yatra sāyaṃgṛhā gatiḥ || 47 ||
nigamair anigamyatvam eva prapañcayati --- amitasyeti | amitasya aparicchinnasya | te mahimnaḥ tvadvaibhavasya | (paraṃ)pāraṃ tīram | prayātuṃ icchatām | vedā eva pānthāḥ nityapathikāḥ | ‘‘pantho ṇa nityam’’ [Pa_5,1.76] iti ṇapratyayaḥ, panthādeśaś ca | teṣāṃ, yatra sāyaṃgṛhā yatra sāyaṃsamayas tad eva gṛhaṃ yasyāṃ sā | gatiḥ | vitathā vyarthā | yathā puruṣāḥ puruṣāyuṣeṇāpy aprāpyaṃ deśaṃ prāptuṃ prasthitāḥ pratidivasam āsāyaṃ gacchanto ’pi na taṃ deśaṃ prāpnuvanti | tathā avāṅyanasagocaraṃ tvanmahimānaṃ pratipādayituṃ pravṛttāḥ vedāḥ śabdagocareṇa sarveṇa prakāreṇa pratipādayanto ’pi na kārtsnyena pratipādayituṃ prabhavantīty arthaḥ | rūpakālaṅkāraḥ || 48 ||
namyasya namataḥ kṣudrān varadasya varārthinaḥ | putraiḥ pitṛmataḥ krīḍā kathaṃ te kena varṇyate || 48 ||
namyasyeti | namyasya sarvalokanamaskartavyasya | kṣudrān alpān indrādīn api | upendrādyavatāraiḥ namataḥ | varadasya sarvalokavarapradāyakasya | tathāpi brahmādiṣu, varārthinaḥ | putraiḥ kāśyapādibhiḥ | pitṛmataḥ | te tava | krīḍā | kathaṃ kena prakāreṇa pravṛttā | kena vā puruṣeṇa varṇyate | acintyas tava krīḍāprakāraḥ | ata eva tava varṇane na ko ’pi śakta ity arthaḥ || 48 ||
naṭavad bhūmikābhedair nātha dīvyan pṛthagvidhaiḥ | puṃsām ananyabhāvānāṃ puṣṇāsi rasam adbhutam || 49 ||
naṭavad iti | he nātha | naṭavat naṭena tulyam | ‘‘tena tulyaṃ kriyā ced vatiḥ’’ [Pa_5,1.115] iti vatipratyayaḥ | pṛthagvidhaiḥ bhūmikābhedaiḥ matsyakūrmādyavatārabhedaiḥ | ‘‘bhūmikā racanāyāṃ syān mūrtyantaraparigrahe |’’ *[n.i.]* iti viśvaḥ | ‘‘tattadveṣo bhūmikā syāt’’ [V_śūdrādhyāyaḥ_68] iti vaijayantī | dīvyan krīḍan | tvaṃ, ananyabhāvānāṃ anyo viṣayatvena nāsti yasya so ’nanyaḥ ananyo bhāvo yeṣāṃ teṣām ekāntinām | adbhutaṃ saṃsāre ananubhūtatvenāścaryabhūtam | rasaṃ apavargānandam | puṣṇāsi abhivyañjayasi | tvadavatārarahasyānucintanaparān apavargadānena yojayasīty arthaḥ | naṭo yathā rāmādyanukāryaveṣabhedair ananyahṛdayānāṃ sāmājikānām adbhutākhyaṃ rasaṃ puṣṇāti tadvad iti bhāvaḥ | upamālaṅkāraḥ || 49 ||
brahmādistambaparyantavicitrāṅkuraśālinām | salilaṃ karmakandānāṃ krīḍaiva tava kevalam || 50 ||
brahmādīti | brahmā ādiḥ pūrvaḥ stambaḥ tṛṇādiḥ paryanta uttarāvadhiḥ yeṣāṃ te brahmādistambaparyantāḥ sarve ’pi prāṇinaḥ ta eva vicitrāṅkurāḥ tacchālināṃ tadbhājām | karmakandānāṃ karmāṇy eva kandāḥ sasyamūlāni teṣāṃ | kevalaṃ tava krīḍaiva salilam | tvatkrīḍāmātrarūpasalilāvasekasahakṛtā eva karmakandā vicitraprapañcarūpān aṅkurān janayantīty arthaḥ | atra bhagavatkrīḍāyāṃ salilatvāroṣasya prapañcāṅkurajananalakṣaṇaprakṛtakāryopayogitvāt pariṇāmālaṃkāraḥ || 50 ||
nirādhāranijasthemno nirupādhikaśeṣiṇaḥ | nirapekṣaniyantus te nissamābhyadhikā guṇāḥ || 51 ||
nirādhāreti | nirādhāra ādhāranirapekṣaḥ nija ātmīyaḥ sthemā sthairyaṃ yasya tasya | nirupādhikaśeṣiṇaḥ svabhāvād eva sakalajagatpradhānabhūtasya | nirapekṣaṃ sahakāryāntaranirapekṣaṃ yathā tathā niyantuḥ jaganniyāmakasya | te | guṇāḥ | nissamābhyadhikāḥ samābhyadhikarahitāḥ | loke hi sthirāṇāṃ bhūdharādīnāṃ sthairyam ādhārasāpekṣam, bhṛtyādīn prati rājñāṃ śeṣitvaṃ bhṛtidānādyupādhiprayuktam, teṣām eva rājyādiniyantṛtvam amātyādisāpekṣam, bhagavatas tv anīdṛśāḥ sthairyādaya iti bhūdharasthairyādibhyas teṣām utkarṣarūpo vyatirekālaṅkāro vyajyate | sa ca vyajyamāno nissamānyadhikatvasya vācyasya sidhyaṅgam iti vācyasiddhyaṅganāmā guṇībhūtavyaṅgyabhedaṃ | sthiraśabdāt ‘‘varṇadṛḍhādibhyaḥ ṣyac ca’’ *[n.i.]* iti cakārādimanic | ‘‘priyasthira’’ [Pa_6,4.157] ityādisūtreṇa sthiraśabdasya sthādeśe ‘‘prakṛtyaikāc’’ [Pa_6,4.163] iti prakṛtibhāve ca sati sthemeti rūpam || 51 ||
anāviladhiyām antaś cintāmaṇir iva sphuran | diśasy abhimataṃ sarvam atiraskāryadī dhitiḥ || 52 ||
anāvileti | atiraskāryadī dhitiḥ tejo ’ntarair anabhibhavanīyaprakāśaḥ | tvam, anāviladhiyāṃ cintāvirodhivyāpārair akaluṣadhiyām | antaḥ hṛdaye | sphuran prakāśamānaḥ, nirantaracintāviṣayīkṛtas san | abhimataṃ abhīpsitam | sarvaṃ diśasi | tān samārān mocayitvā ‘‘sa yadi pitṛlokakāmo bhavati saṃkalpād evāsya pitaras samuttiṣṭhanti’’ [ChU_8,2.1] ityādimuktaviṣayaśrutyuktaprakriyayā saṃkalpamātreṇa tadabhilapitaṃ sarvaṃ prayacchasīty arthaḥ | cintāmaṇir iva | so ’pi divyaratnatayā tejo ’ntarair anabhibhavanīyaprakāśaḥ | cintito ’bhimatam arthaṃ dadāti || 52 ||
saṃsāramarukāntāre pariśrāntasya dehinaḥ | tvadbhaktyamṛtavāhinyām ādiṣṭam avagāhanam || 53 ||
saṃsāreti | saṃsāra eva maruḥ nirjalapradeśaḥ sukharahitatvena nīrasatvāt tasya kāntāraṃ durgamaṃ vartma, iṣṭāpūrtādikāriṇām ihāmutra ca gatāgatasādhanadhūmādimārgarūpam, pāpināṃ tṛtīyasthānarūpā kaṣṭā durgatiś ca | ‘‘kāntāraṃ vartma durgamam’’ [AK_2,1.36] ity amaraḥ | tatra, pariśrāntasya gatāgatābhyāṃ khinnasya | dehinaḥ śarīriṇaḥ | tvadbhaktir eva amṛtavāhinī sudhānadī tasyām | avagāhanam | ādiṣṭaṃ gatāgataśramaharatvenopadiṣṭam, ‘‘bhaktyā tv ananyayā śakyaḥ aham evaṃvidho ’rjuna | jñātuṃ draṣṭuṃ ca tattvena praveṣṭuṃ ca parantapa |’’ [BG_11.54] ityādāv ity arthaḥ | atra bhaktāv amṛtavāhinītvāropasya saṃsārādhvaśramaharaṇakāryopayogitvāt pariṇāmālaṃkāraḥ || 53 ||
duritodanvadāvarte ghūrṇamānasya duḥkhyataḥ | samagraguṇasampannas tārakas tvaṃ plavo mahān || 54 ||
duriteti | duritam eva udanvān samudraḥ tasyāvarte jalabhrame | ‘‘syād āvarto ’mbhasāṃ bhramaḥ |’’ [AK_1,10.528] ity amaraḥ | āvarta ity upacārād duritaparipākaḥ tasmin, ghūrṇamānasya paribhrāmyataḥ | duḥkhyataḥ kliśyataḥ | duḥkhaśabdasya kaṇḍvādiṣu pāṭhād yakpratyayaḥ | dehinaḥ śaraṇāgatasyeti bhāvaḥ | samagrāḥ aparicchinnā guṇā jñānaśaktyādaya eva guṇāḥ sūtrāṇi taiḥ saṃpannaḥ samṛddhaḥ | tvam eva, mahān plava iti vyastarūpakam | tārakaḥ tārayitā | pūrvatra bhakteḥ muktyupāyatvam uktaṃ iha tu prapatter iti bhedaḥ | pūrvavat pariṇāmālaṅkāraḥ || 54 ||
aparicchidyamānasya deśakālādibhis tava | nidarśanaṃ tvam evaikas tvadanyadvyatirekataḥ || 55 ||
aparicchidyamānasyeti | deśakālādibhiḥ vibhutvād deśena nityatvāt kālena sarvātmakatvāt vastunā cāparicchidyamānasya | tava | tvam eka eva | nidarśanaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ | tvadanyat vyāpitvādinā prasiddhaṃ gaganādi | vyatirekataḥ | nidarśanam ity anuṣaṅgaḥ | gaganādivad deśaparicchinno na bhavatītyādikrameṇa vyatirekadṛṣṭānto bhavatīty arthaḥ | atra nidarśanaṃ tvam evaika ity ekasyaiva upamānopameyabhāvād ananvayaḥ | tvadanyadvyatirekata iti gaganādito bhagavadutkarṣavarṇanād vyatirekaś ceti tayor anyonyānuprāṇitatvena saṃkaraḥ || 55 ||
akartum akhilaṃ kartum anyathā kartum apy alam | saṅkalpasacivaḥ kāle śaktileśas sa tāvakaḥ || 56 ||*
akartum iti | akhilaṃ prapañcam | kāle tattaducitasamaye | akartuṃ kartuṃ anyathā kartum api pralayeṣv akartuṃ sargādiṣu kartuṃ manvantarabhedeṣu pūrvendrādyadhikāraṃ vinivartya indrāntarāṇāṃ sthāpanakrameṇānyathā kartuṃ ca | saṅkalpasacivaḥ tvatsaṅkalpasahāyaḥ | ‘‘sahāyasacivau’’ *[n.i.]* iti vaijayantī | tāvakaḥ śaktileśaḥ tvadīyaśaktileśarūpaḥ | sa kāla eva | alaṃ paryāptaḥ | tvacchaktileśa eva jagadvyāpārāya paryāptaḥ | tava paripūrṇaśaktiḥ kathaṃ lakṣyata iti bhāvaḥ | ‘‘tataḥ kālātmako yo ’sau tavāṃśaḥ kathyate hareḥ |’’ *[n.i.]* ityādau kālasya bhagavacchaktileśatvaṃ prasiddham || 56 ||

yan mūlam akhilaṃ kāryaṃ yad amūlam adhīyate | lakṣyaṃ tad asi yogānāṃ lakṣmīkaustubhalakṣaṇam || 57 ||
yan mūlam iti | akhilaṃ viyadādi | kāryam | yan mūlaṃ yat kāraṇakam | yat amūlaṃ akāraṇakam | adhīyate ‘‘na cāsya kaścij janitā na cādhipaḥ’’ [SU_6.9] ityādyupaniṣatsu | tat lakṣmīkaustubhalakṣaṇaṃ lakṣmīḥ kaustubhākhyo maṇiś ca cihnaṃ yasya tathābhūtam | yogānāṃ daharopāsanādiparavidyānām | lakṣyaṃ uddeśyaṃ paraṃ brahma asi || 57 ||
trivargam apavargaṃ vā pratilabdhuṃ prayasyatām | pralayeṣv api dīrghāyuḥ pratibhūs tvadanugrahaḥ || 58 ||
trivargam iti | trayāṇāṃ dharmārthakāmānāṃ vargaḥ tam | ‘‘trivargo dharmakāmārthaiḥ’’ [AK_2,6.931] ity amaraḥ | apavargaṃ mokṣaṃ vā | pratiladbhuṃ prāptum | prayasyatāṃ prayatamānānām | tvadanugrahaḥ tava prasādaḥ | pralayeṣv api | dīrghāyuḥ | pratibhūḥ lagnakaḥ | yathā vṛddhyājīvāḥ pratibhuvaṃ viśvasya vṛddhyarthaṃ dhanaṁ prayuñjate, tathā santaḥ tvatprasādam eva kalpāntareṣv api phalapradaṃ viśvasya trivargāpavargārthāni karmāṇi anutiṣṭhanti | agnyāditattatkarmadevatānāṃ kalpāntareṣv asaṃbhavād iti bhāvaḥ | bhagavatprasāde pratibhūtvāropasya prayāsarūpaprastutakāryopayogitvāt pariṇāmālaṅkāraḥ || 58 ||
yad ekam akṣaraṃ brahma sarvāmnāyasamanvitam | tārakaṃ sarvajantūnāṃ tat tvaṃ tava ca vācakam || 59 ||*
yadekam iti | sarvāmnāyasamanvitaṃ sarveṣu vedeṣv ādyantayoḥ samanvitam | ‘‘brahmaṇaḥ praṇavaṃ kuryād ādāv ante ca sarvadā |’’ [MSm_2.74] iti smṛteḥ | sarvajantūnām | tārakaṃ bhavārṇavataraṇopāyabhūtam | yat ekaṃ akṣaraṃ brahma ekākṣararūpaṃ śabdabrahma ‘‘om ity ekākṣaraṃ brahma’’ [BG_8.13] iti prasiddham | tat | tvam | tava | vācakaṃ abhidhānaṃ ca | ‘‘aum iti brahma’’ [?] | ‘‘aum tat sad iti nirdeśo brahmaṇas trividhaḥ smṛtaḥ |’’ [BG_17.23] ityādiṣu praṇavarūpatayā praṇavavācyatayā ca varṇitaṃ paraṃ brahma tvam evety arthaḥ || 59 ||

raśanāratnarūpeṇa payodhiraśanā tvayā | praśāntadanujakleśā pariṣkaraṇam arhati || 82 ||
raśaneti | payodhiraśanā samudramekhalā pṛthivī | raśanāratnarūpeṇa samudraśāyitvena pṛthvīmekhalāyā ratnatulyena | tvayā | praśāntadanujakleśā satī | parīṣkaraṇaṃ prasādhanam | arhati | kleśam anubhavantyāḥ kiṃ pariṣkaraṇeneti daityopasaṃhāreṇa kleśam apanīya pariṣkaraṇīyeti bhāvaḥ | ‘‘nibhasaṃkāśanīkāśapratikāśopamādayaḥ’’ [AK_2,8.1471] ity amarakośavyākhyātṛbhirādiśabdena bhūtarūpakalpādīnāṃ grahaṇam ity ukte ratnaṃ rūpaśabdas tulyavācī | ata eva upamopakramotprekṣālaṃkāraḥ | tasya svarūpavācitve tu raśanāratnatvāropaḥ pariṣkaraṇakāryopayogīti pariṇāmālaṃkāraḥ || 82 ||
kaṃsaprabhṛtibhis seyaṃ śalyair iva samuddhṛtaiḥ | ciraṃ bhavatu te pṛthvī śeṣamūrteḥ śikhaṇḍakaḥ || 83 ||
kaṃseti | sā tathā kleśam anubhavantī | iyaṃ sannihitā pṛthvī | śalyaiḥ antaḥ praviṣṭaiḥ śarair iva | samuddhṛtaiḥ | kaṃsaprabhṛtibhiḥ | ciram | te tava | śeṣātmikāyā mūrteḥ śikhaṇḍakaḥ kākapakṣaḥ | bhavatu | daityopasaṃhāreṇa lāghavaṃ prāptā bhūmiḥ | śeṣasya śikhaṇḍakavat suvahā bhavatv ity arthaḥ | anena daityānupasaṃhāre śeṣasyāpi mahābhāra iti sūcitam | śalyair ivety upamā śikhaṇḍaka iti rūpakaṃ ceti tayoḥ saṃsṛṣṭiḥ | samuddhṛtaiḥ kaṃsaprabhṛtibhir iti viśiṣṭahetutvavidhiḥ ‘‘dadhnā juhoti’’ *[n.i.]* iti nyāyena viśeṣaṇavidhiparyavasanna iti kaṃsādisamuddharaṇasyaiva suvahatānimittatvam atra vivakṣitam || 83 ||
prabodhasubhagaiḥ smeraiḥ prasannaiḥ śītalaiś ca naḥ | kaṭākṣaiḥ plāvaya kṣipraṃ kṛpaikodanvadūrmibhiḥ || 84 ||*
prabodheti | prabodhena yoganidrāpagamena subhagaiḥ cakṣuṣyaiḥ | ‘‘cakṣuṣyaḥ subhagataḥ kāntaḥ’’ *[n.i.]* iti yādavaḥ | prasannaiḥ bhrūvilāsamandasmitānugataiḥ | ‘‘tat prasannaṃ bhavet sabhrūvilāsaṃ vismitaṃ ca yat |’’ [BP_5] {1} iti lakṣaṇam | smeraiḥ harṣavikāsibhiḥ | bhaktajanatāpaharatvenopacārāt śītalaiś ca | kṛpaiva eko mukhya udanvān tasyormibhiḥ | kaṭākṣaiḥ apāṅgadarśanaiḥ | naḥ asmān | kṣipram | plāvaya secaya | atra kṛpāyās samudratvarūpaṇasya kaṭākṣāṇām ūrmitvarūpaṇasya ca paramparā sañjāteti paramparitarūpakālaṅkāraḥ || 84 ||
{1}: I have the following reading: tat prasannaṃ bhavet sabhrūvilāsaṃ sasmitañ ca yat
* Another reading: prabodhasubhagair asmān prasannaiḥ smeraśītalaiḥ | kaṭākṣaiḥ plāvaya kṣipraṃ kṛpaikodanvadūrmibhiḥ ||
tvayi nyastabharāṇāṃ nas tvam etāṃ kṣantum arhasi | viditāśeṣavedyasya vijñāpanaviḍambanām || 85 ||*
tvayīti | tvayi nyastabharāṇāṃ bharanyāsaṃ śaraṇāgatim anuṣṭhitavatām | naḥ asmākaṃ | viditāśeṣavedyasya | taveti śeṣaḥ | etāṃ vijñāpanam eva viḍambanāṃ anucitakṛtyam | tvam | kṣantuṃ arhasi || 85 ||
* Another reading: tvayi vinyastabhārāṇāṃ tvam etāṃ kṣantum arhasi | viditāśeṣavedyasya vijñāpanaviḍambanām ||
itthaṃ vadati devānāṃ samāje vedhasā saha | vavande pṛthivī devaṃ vinatatrāṇadīkṣitam || 86 ||*
ittham iti | devānām | samāje samūhe | vedhāsā brahmaṇā saha | itthaṃ vadati sati | pṛthivī | vinatatrāṇe dīkṣitaṃ kṛtavratam | devam | vavande || 86 ||
* Another reading: vedhasā saha --> saha vedhasā
tanumadhyā viśālākṣī tanvī pīnapayodharā | māyeva mahatī tasya vanitāratnarūpiṇī || 87 ||
tanumadhyeti | tanvī tanvaṅgī | tanumadhyā madhyabhāge tato ’pi tanīyasī | viśālākṣī dīrghalocanā | pīnapayodharā pīvarastanī | vanitāratnaṃ vanitottamā, ‘‘ratnaṃ svajātiśreṣṭhe ’pi’’ [AK_3,3.607] ity amaraḥ | tadrūpam asyā astīti tathoktā | tasya bhagavato mahatī māyeva sthitā | atimohanarūpeṇa ‘‘mūrtā viṣṇor mahāmāyā’’ *[n.i.]* ity utprekṣaṇīyā | vavanda iti pūrveṇa saṃbandhaḥ || 87 ||
ābaddhamaṇḍalair bhṛṅgair alakāmodamohitaiḥ | ayatnalabdhāṃ bibhrāṇā māyūracchatrasaṃpadam || 88 ||
ābaddheti | alakāḥ kuṭilakeśāḥ | ‘‘alakāś cūrṇakuntalāḥ |’’ [AK_2,5.721] ity amaraḥ | teṣām āmodena saurabheṇa mohitaiḥ paravaśīkṛtaiḥ | ata eva, ābaddhamaṇḍalaiḥ apari maṇḍalam ābadhya bhramadbhiḥ | bhṛṅgaiḥ | ayatnena labdhām, māyūracchatrasaṃpadaṃ mayūrapatrakṛtātapatraśobhām | bibhrāṇā | ‘‘śobhārthe ’pi prayujyante lakṣmī śrīkāntisaṃpadaḥ |’’ *[n.i.]* iti halāyudhaḥ | atra rājamahiṣīṇām ucitaṃ mayūracchatradhāraṇaṃ bhṛṅgaiḥ saṃpāditam iti bhinnavibhaktinirdiṣṭānāṃ bhṛṅgāṇāṃ māyūracchatrarūpeṇa pariṇāmād vyadhikaraṇapariṇāmālaṅkāraḥ || 88 ||
priyasaṃdarśanānandajanitair aśrubindubhiḥ | nyastamauktikanaipathyaiḥ pariṣkṛtapayodharā || 89 ||
priyeti | priyasya sandarśanāt yaḥ ānandaḥ tena janitaiḥ | nyastamauktikanaipathyaiḥ niveśitamauktikābharaṇaiḥ | aśrubindubhiḥ | pariṣkṛtapayodharā | atra ānandabāṣpabindūnāṃ paṅktir eva payodharamatamauktikanaipathyatvenādhyavasiteti bhede abhedarūpātiśayoktir alaṅkāraḥ || 89 ||
prasphurantaṃ priyasyeva parirambhābhilāṣiṇam | dakṣiṇād itaraṃ bāhuṃ dakṣiṇā bahv amanyata || 90 ||*
prasphurantam iti | dakṣiṇā pravīṇā śubhāśubhanimittajñā | prakarṣeṇa sphurantam | ata eva, priyasya parirambhābhilāṣiṇaṃ priyaparirambhaṃ abhīkṣṇaṃ abhilaṣantam iva sthitam | atyantābhilāṣeṇa tvaramāṇo hi bhramati naikatrāvatiṣṭhate | dakṣiṇād itaraṃ vāmam | bāhum | bahu yathā tathā amanyata | ‘‘vāmabhāgaś ca nārīṇāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ puṃsān tu dakṣiṇaḥ | dāne devādipūjāyāṃ spande ’laṅkaraṇe ’pi ca |’’ iti smṛteḥ śubhasūcakatayā prāśastyāt bahumene | bāhau parirambhābhilāṣitvasaṃbhāvanād utprekṣālaṅkāraḥ || 90 ||
* Another reading: prasphurantaṃ priyasyeva parirambhābhilāṣiṇam | bahv amanyata sā bāhuṃ dakṣiṇā dakṣiṇetaram ||
vipadaṃ ca jagādaiṣā vipañcī madhurasvanā | vilakṣasmitasaṃbhinnamauktikādharavidrumā || 91 ||
vipadam iti | vipañcī vīṇeva madhurasvanā hṛdyasvanā | eṣā pṛthvī | vilakṣasmitaṃ vismayānvitasmitam, ‘‘vilakṣo vismayānvitaḥ |’’ [AK_3,1.53] ity amaraḥ | lajjānvitasmitaṃ vā | ‘‘ātmanaḥ skhalite samyak jñāte ’nyair yasya jāyate | apatrapātimahatī sa vilakṣa iti smṛtaḥ |’’ *[n.i.]* iti lajjāviśeṣaviśiṣṭasya tatsāmānyavaiśiṣṭyalakṣaṇāsaṃbhavāt; saṃbhinnaḥ mauktikaḥ yasmin tathoktaḥ vilakṣasmitena saṃbhinnamauktikaḥ mauktikasaṃbhedavān adhara eva vidrumo yasyās sā tathābhūtā satī | vipadaṃ jagāda ca | pūrvaślokakriyāsamuccayārthaś cakāraḥ | atra vipañcī madhurasvanety upamā | smitasya mauktikatvenādharasya vidrumatvena ca rūpaṇāt rūpakañ ceti tayoḥ saṃsṛṣṭiḥ || 91 ||
atha tān bhavyayā vācā bhagavān pratyabhāṣata | pratiśrut prāptanirhrādapāñcajanyābhinandyayā || 92 ||
atheti | atha dharaṇīvacanānantaram | bhagavān | bhavyayā kalyāṇyā | pratiśrut pratidhvaniḥ tayā prāptanirhrādasya labdhaghoṣasya pāñcajanyasya bhagavacchaṅkhasya abhinandyayā, pratidhvanimatā pāñcajanyenābhinandyamānayeva sthitayeti gamyotprekṣā | evaṃbhūtayā, vācā | tān devān | pratyabhāṣata | pratidhvanikāritayā bhagavaddhvaner atigambhīratvaṃ vyajyate || 92 ||
mā bhaiṣur asurānīkād bhavanto madupāśrayāḥ | madājñām anavajñātuḥ paribhūtyā na bhūyate || 93 ||
mā bhaiṣur iti | aham upāśrayaḥ śaraṇaṃ yeṣāṃ te madupāśrayāḥ | bhavantaḥ | asurānīkāt daityasainyāt | mā bhaiṣuḥ mā trāsiṣu | bhavacchabdayogena yuṣmadupapadasya sthānino ’py abhāvāt ‘‘śeṣe prathamaḥ’’ [Pa_1,4.108] | madājñāṃ anavajñātuḥ madājñān atilaṅghanaśīlasya | tācchīlye tṛnpratyayo ’yam | tadyoge ‘‘na lokāvyaya’’ [Pa_2,3.69] ityādinā ṣaṣṭhīniṣedhāt madājñām iti dvitīyā | paribhūtyā paribhavena | na bhūyate bhāve laṭ | madājñām anuvarttamānānāṃ na kuto ’pi paribhavo bhavatīty arthaḥ | mā bhaiṣur iti ñibhībhaya iti dhātor luṅ | māḍayogādaḍāgamābhāvaḥ | mā bhaiṣur ity arthe uttaravākyārthasya hetutvenānvayād vākyārthahetukaṃ kāvyaliṅgam alaṅkāraḥ || 93 ||
avatārya bhuvo bhāram avatāro mamāmarāḥ | anādinidhanaṃ dharmam akṣataṃ sthāpayiṣyati || 94 ||
avatāryeti | he amarāḥ | mama avatāraḥ | bhuvo bhāraṃ daityabhāram | avatārya | anādinidhanaṃ anantakālapravāheṇa ekarūpeṇa pravṛttam | dharmam | akṣataṃ sthāpayiṣyati || 94 ||
yāvad iṣṭabhujo yāvad adhikāram avasthitāḥ | paripālayata svāni padāni vigatāpadaḥ || 95 ||
yāvad iti | vigatāpadaḥ madavatāreṇa daityānām upasaṃhāre sati apahatāpadaḥ | yāvad iṣṭabhujaḥ yāvad iṣṭaṃ bhuñjānāḥ, yāvantīṣṭāni yāgādīni tāvanti bhuñjānā ity arthaḥ | yāvad adhikāraṃ avasthitāś ca santaḥ | svāni padāni sthānāni | paripālayata | yāvadiṣṭaṃ yāvadadhikāraśabdayoḥ ‘‘yāvad avadhāraṇe’’ [Pa_2,1.8] ity avyayībhāvaḥ || 95 ||
damanād danujendrāṇāṃ drakṣyatha tridaśādhipāḥ | bhūyo ’pi laghutāṃ prāptāṃ bhuvam ullāghitām iva || 96 ||
damanād iti | he tridaśādhipāḥ suraśreṣṭhāḥ | danujendrāṇām asurapradhānānām | damanāt | bhūyo ’pi yathāpūrvam | laghutāṃ prāptām | bhuvam | ullāghitāṃ vyādhim uktīkṛtām iva | drakṣyatha vilokayiṣyatha | ‘‘ullāgho nirgato gadāt |’’ [AK_2,5.643] ity amaraḥ | ullāghaśabdāt tat karotīti ṇyantāt karmaṇi niṣṭhā || 96 ||
daiteyamṛgasaṅghāte mṛgayā rasabhāgibhiḥ | bhavadbhir api medinyāṃ bhavitavyaṃ narādhipaiḥ || 97 ||
daiteyeti | medinyām | bhavadbhir api | daiteyāḥ asurā eva mṛgāḥ teṣāṃ saṅghāte | mṛgayā yātrā tasyāṃ rasabhāgibhiḥ kautukabhāgbhiḥ | narādhipaiḥ | bhavitavyaṃ bhavanto ’pi keṣāñcid duṣṭānāṃ vadhārthaṃ kṣatriyakuleṣv avatarantv ity arthaḥ | ‘‘saṃpṛcānurudha’’ [Pā_3,2.142] ityādisūtreṇa bhajidhātor ghinuṇpratyaye ‘‘ca joḥ ku ghiṇṇyatoḥ’’ [Pa_7,3.52] iti kutve ca bhāgiśabdaḥ || 97 ||
iti tān anaghādeśas samādiśya janārdanaḥ | avadhīritadugdhābdhir mathurāyāṃ mano dadhe || 98 ||
itīti | anaghādeśaḥ apratihataniyogaḥ | janārdanaḥ | iti uktaprakāreṇa | tān vibudhān | samādiśya | avadhīritadugdhābdhiḥ avamatakṣīrāmbudhiḥ san | mathurāyāṃ mano dadhe, dugdhābdhiṃ vihāya mathurāyām avataritavyam iti aicchad ity arthaḥ | ‘‘eṣa nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmān kṣīrārṇavaniketanaḥ | nāgaparyaṅkam utsṛjya hy āgato mathurāṃ purīm |’’ [MBh(s)_3,86.20] iti bhāgavatavacanārtho ’trānusahitaḥ || 98 ||
āśvāsya vāgamṛtavṛṣṭibhir āditeyān daiteyabhāranamitāṃ pṛthivīṃ ca devīm | prādurbubhūṣur anagho vasudevapatnyāṃ padmāpatiḥ praṇidadhe samayaṃ dayāyāḥ || 99 ||
atha ‘‘sarvatra bhinnasargāntaiḥ’’ *[n.i.]* iti lakṣaṇānurodhāt sargāvasāne vṛttāntaram āha --- āśvāsyeti | anagho niravadyaḥ tattatkarmānurodhitayā vaiṣamyanairghṛṇyadoṣarahitaḥ | padmāpatiḥ śrīpatiḥ | vāgevāmṛtaṃ tasya vṛṣṭibhiḥ | aditer apatyāni āditeyā devāḥ tān | aditiśabdāt ‘‘kṛdikārādaktinaḥ’’ iti ṅīṣpratyaye, ‘‘strībhyo ḍhak’’ [Pa_4,1.120] iti ḍhakpratyaye ca rūpam | evaṃ daiteyaśabdo ’pi | daiteyānāṃ bhāreṇa namitām | pṛthivīṃ devīṃ ca | āśvāsya | vasudevasya patnyāṃ devakyām | prādurbubhūṣuḥ prādurbhavitum icchus san | dayāyāḥ | samayaṃ avasaram | praṇidadhe dadhyau | asurapīḍītānāṃ prāṇināṃ devakīvasudevayoś ca dayanīyatayā tattatkarmānusāreṇa samayaṃ pratīkṣitavān ity arthaḥ | vasantatilakākhyam idaṃ vṛttam || 99 ||
sādhūnāṃ svapadasarojaṣaṭpadānāṃ dharmasya sthitim anaghāṃ vidhātukāmaḥ | yadgarbhaṃ jagad akhilaṃ sa eva garbho devakyāḥ samajani devadevavandyaḥ || 100 ||
sādhūnām iti | akhilam | jagat | yadgarbhaṃ yasya kukṣistham | ‘‘kukṣau kukṣisthite jantau garbhaḥ’’ *[n.i.]* iti nānārthe vaijayantī | devānām api devāḥ brahmādayaḥ teṣām api vandyaḥ | sa eva vāsudevaḥ | svasya padam eva sarojaṃ padmaṃ tasya ṣaṭpadānāṃ bhramarāṇāṃ saroje bhramaravat svacaraṇe āsaktānām | sādhūnām | dharmasya sthitiṃ maryādām | anaghāṃ nirdoṣām | vidhātukāmaḥ vidhitsus san | devakyā garbhaḥ | samajani saṃjātaḥ | janidhātor luṅi ‘‘dīpajana’’ [Pa_3,1.61] ityādinā kartari ciṇ | vidhātukāma ity atra vidhātuṃ kāmo yasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ | vidhātuṃ kāmaḥ kāmanāvān iti vā | mayūravyasakāditvāt samāsaḥ | ‘‘tuṃ kāmamanasor api’’ [KV_6,1.144] iti malopaḥ | devakasyāpatyaṃ daivakī iti vṛddhipāṭhas sādhur ityātreyaḥ | avṛddha eva prasiddhaḥ | tathā yamakaratnākare ’pi prayogo dṛśyate | ‘‘akhilasya yo ’sya jagato yo nirmātā ca devakī yasya | śarmaṇa ihāvatārair yonir mātā ca devakī yasya |’’ *[n.i.]* iti | saṃbhavati cāṇpratyayāntatve ’py avṛddhatvaṃ jyotiṣavat, saṃjñāpūrvakavidhitvena vṛddhiśāstrasyānityatvāt | svapadasarojety atra paraṃparitarūpakālaṅkāraḥ | praharṣaṇīvṛttam etat || 100 ||
iti kavitārkikasiṃhasya sarvatantrasvatantrasya śrīmadveṅkaṭanāthasya vedāntācāryasya kṛtiṣu yādavābhyudaye mahākāvye prathama sargaḥ ||
itīti | itiśabdaḥ samāptivācī prathamaḥ sarga ity etadanvayī | kavayaḥ kāvyakṛtaḥ, tarkeṇa dīvyantīti tārkikāḥ vādinaḥ ‘‘tena divyati’’ iti *[n.i.]* ṭhakpratyayaḥ, teṣāṃ siṃhasya paripanthibhūtānāṃ teṣāṃ siṃhavadbhayaṅkarasya teṣu śreṣṭhasyeti vā ‘‘siṃhaśārdūlanāgādyāḥ puṃsi śreṣṭhārthagocarāḥ |’’ [AK_3,1.121] ity amaraḥ | sarveṣu tantreṣu siddhānteṣu nyāyavaiśeṣikapūrvottaramīmāṃsāsāṅkhyayogaśaivavaiṣṇavādiṣu svatantrasya svecchayā kaṃcid arthaṃ sthāpayituṃ dūṣayituṃ vā śaktasya | vedāntācāryasya vedāntarahasyārthopadeṣṭuḥ | śrīmadveṅkaṭanāthasya | kṛtiṣu prabandheṣu | ‘‘yataś ca nirdvāraṇe’’ *[n.i.]* iti saptamī | tatkṛtaprabandhānāṃ maddhya ity arthaḥ | yādavābhyudaye yādavasya kṛṣṇasya abhyudayaṃ viṣayīkṛtya kṛte, ‘‘adhikṛtya kṛte granthe’’ [Pa_4,3.87] iti prāptasyāṇpratyayasya ‘‘lubākhyāyikābhyo bahulam’’ [MB_4,3.87] iti lup | ‘‘sargair anativistīrṇaiḥ śrāvyavṛttais susaṃdhibhiḥ | sarvatra bhinnasargāntair upetaṃ lokarañjanam |’’ [SPr_11.75] ity uktamahākāvyalakṣaṇayukte prabandhe | prathamaḥ sargaḥ | iti samāpta ity arthaḥ ||
iti śrīmadbhāradvājakulajaladhikaustubhaśrīviśvajidyājiśrīraṅgarājādhvarivarasūnunā appayyadīkṣitena viracite yādavābhyudayavyākhyāne prathama sargaḥ ||
